surfacePolicy.customerMobile: Use shared RideX mobile base surfaces and semantic state colors; task-first layouts.
surfacePolicy.driverMobile: Primary/neutral palette aligned to Admin Web and Admin Mobile in this point.
surfacePolicy.adminWeb: Existing CSS variables are reference palette; preserve responsive grid and focus styling.
surfacePolicy.gatewayAndroid: Dark operational console is an intentional surface-specific exception; retain dark contrast and semantic states.
surfacePolicy.superAdminControl: Private-control trust boundary; avoid weakening step-up/security states for visual consistency.
surfacePolicy.publicWebsite: Use same brand primary and accessible text/background contrast.

responsiveRules: Use flexible widths and min-width:0 in dense rows/grids; avoid horizontal overflow on narrow screens.
Forms and dialogs must constrain width to viewport and scroll within viewport where necessary.
Touch targets and keyboard focus must remain visible; do not communicate status by color alone.
Text scaling must not clip primary actions, errors, OTP expiry or privileged confirmation content.
Gateway dark theme is permitted as a deliberate operational-console exception.
statusNotes: Driver Mobile and unified test-client Driver palette aligned to reference brand/neutral tokens.
This does not claim all component tokens are centralized or every surface visually identical.
Browser/device, accessibility, font-scale and responsive visual evidence remain deferred per user instruction.

completed: P4-E static main journey state-path mapping
P4-F primary driver palette alignment and cross-surface token rules
checkpoint.next: P4-G independent app navigation shells, identities, routes and environment indicators
checkpoint.resumeRule: Resume at P4-G; physical visual QA remains deferred until all four packages are implemented.
